Midnight Beasts' Vow

After ten years of marriage shatter, a woman's pet cat and dog expose her husband's infidelity. To make matters worse, he has secretly funneled their marital assets to his mistress. Endowed with the ability to communicate with animals, she assembles a bizarre but formidable animal army: rats, bees, owls, giant Scottish rats, wolves, tigers, giant spiders, and more. She engages in a hilarious yet dramatically tense showdown against her husband, his mistress, and the mistress's uncle—who also understands animal communication—to reclaim the wealth stolen from her. Packed with comedic moments and thrilling confrontations, the story follows her as she outsmarts her enemies and ultimately regains her freedom alongside her loyal animal companions.
